svg.title: Active Directory risk review placeholder
svg.desc: Placeholder checklist for duplicate Windows machine identity risk during a Full Stack DR drill.
svg.text: Review the Active Directory drill risk
[ ] Windows computer name and NetBIOS name documented
[ ] Domain FQDN and domain controller CIDRs documented
[ ] Source VNICs identified for each protected server
[ ] Drill copy must not reach Active Directory
Replace with risk table or OCI/Windows inventory screenshot.
